_doc: Per-source config, owner only (opened copy company/state/modules/intake/limits/sources.json, changed through harness-change.js kind policy). sources.<id>.trust: "internal" marks a source's events trusted (default and anything else: untrusted). sources.<id>.expect: { minPerHour?, maxSilenceMin, activeHours?: "08:00-20:00", days?: "mon-fri", tz? } is the expected cadence; quiet longer than maxSilenceMin inside the window emits one `silence` event per episode. sources.<id>.party: party id for those events. Shipped closed: no source is internal, none has an expectation (all show as unwatched).
